# Arnav Prabhu

> Applied AI builder and finance student at the University of Texas at Dallas. Builds and ships LLM systems — RAG pipelines, multi-agent orchestration, and AI products in finance.

Arnav Prabhu is an undergraduate at UT Dallas pursuing dual B.S. degrees in Finance and Business Analytics & AI. He builds applied AI systems end-to-end: retrieval-augmented generation over unstructured documents, multi-agent orchestration frameworks, and agentic workflows, grounded in financial analysis, risk management, and quantitative methods.

## Projects

- **Axton** — AI-powered SEC filing intelligence platform with a RAG pipeline for 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K filings. Built with Next.js, Supabase, and Gemini AI. https://axton.arnavprabhu.com
- **pi-swarm** — Multi-agent orchestration framework built on pi.dev. Organizes AI agents into a 3-tier company hierarchy with 21 specialist roles. Model-agnostic with real-time cost tracking and a live terminal UI. https://github.com/arnavprabhu/pi-swarm
- **Doxa** — AI-powered equity research pipeline coordinating six specialized agents across market data, valuation, SEC filings, sentiment, writing, and editorial review to produce high-signal reports. https://github.com/UnitedDiagram/Doxa

## Expertise

- LLM applications, RAG architectures, multi-agent systems, machine learning
- Financial modeling, risk management, quantitative analysis, corporate finance
